context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 135 verified the EGA IAC task status polling feature. The ega_tasks collection stores task records with status (running/completed/error), items_added, duplicates_skipped, and duplicate_titles fields. Dashboard and Checklist pages poll /api/guardian/iac-task-status every 4 seconds and show banners when EGA is generating IAC items. The downloadFile utility in /app/frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.js provides cross-platform PDF downloads (web uses standard download, iOS/Capacitor uses Filesystem API + Share sheet). Rate limiting is active on login endpoint - wait 15+ seconds between login attempts if hitting 429 errors.
